ValidationRule.description: Prevent credit referral case closure if the status of the assessment outcome is approved/declined. Case can only be closed after finalisation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Credit_Referral", System_Action__c = false, OR( Assessment_Outcome__c = "Approved", Assessment_Outcome__c = "Declined" ), OR( PRIORVALUE(Status) <> "Closed - Approved", PRIORVALUE(Status) <> "Closed - Declined" ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed - Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed - Declined") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can't close the case. Please click 'Finalise Assessment' to complete your assessment which will automatically close the case.
